title: Boba Fett
subtitle: Mandalorian
description: After he was unceremoniously cast into the Sarlacc, Boba Fett pulled himself out, only to be captured by a wandering tribe of Tusken Raiders. Fett assimilated himself into the Tusken society until the Pykes wiped them out. Having regained both his Mandalorian armor and his umistakable ship, Fett executed his revenge and made himself daimyo of Mos Espa in that process.
